title: Titanium Chainring Bolt
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this drivetrain hardware application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by chainring fixing bolt set (m6) and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turning Swiss-type for drivetrain hardware geometry
Thread rolling DIN 13-1 6g with 0.5mm corner radius
Go/No-Go ring gauging with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for chainring fixing bolt application
commonFailures: Thread galling Ti-on-Ti assembly - prevented by MoS2 anti-seize compound and -20% installation torque — critical for chainring fixing bolt performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Chainring Bolt suitable for Chainring fixing bolt set (M6)?
faq.a: Titanium Chainring Bolt uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address drivetrain hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Chainring Bolt?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Chainring Bolt is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for chainring fixing bolt requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Chainring Bolt require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. chainring fixing bolt components require Bead blasting 120 grit Al2O3 for matte finish Ra 1.6-3.2um followed by passive oxide stabilization in DI water — tailored for chainring fixing bolt application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Chainring Bolt shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Chainring Bolt includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet chainring fixing bolt specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
